response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, demonstrable leadership in AI-agent infrastructure, and deep exposure to cloud platforms and agentic workflows — aligning well with core responsibilities. However, he lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years in production-grade AI solutions, direct RAG/vector DB implementation, and enterprise customer-facing technical leadership, which are critical for the staff-level role.
strengths: Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven ability to lead technical projects across diverse stacks and domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical mentoring through workshops
concerns: No clear documentation of 8+ years in production AI systems; most roles are general software engineering
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architectures in resume
Limited evidence of direct enterprise customer-facing technical leadership or consulting

key_factors.factor: Lack of proven RAG/vector DB work
